description: Source code for SDL_ttf, a library for rendering TrueType fonts with SDL, including font loading, glyph caching, and text rendering functions.

classes.name: _TTF_Font
classes.description: Internal structure holding font data, including FreeType face, glyph cache, style, and metrics.

methods.name: TTF_Linked_Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the linked SDL_ttf library.

methods.name: TTF_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SDL_ttf library and FreeType.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFont
methods.description: Opens a font file at a specified size.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFontIndex
methods.description: Opens a font file at a specified size and font index.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFontRW
methods.description: Opens a font from an SDL_RWops stream.

methods.name: TTF_CloseFont
methods.description: Closes and frees a font.

methods.name: TTF_SetFontStyle
methods.description: Sets the style (bold, italic, underline) for a font.

methods.name: TTF_GetFontStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the current style of a font.

methods.name: TTF_WasInit
methods.description: Checks if SDL_ttf has been initialized.

methods.name: TTF_Quit
methods.description: Shuts down the SDL_ttf library.

methods.name: TTF_FontHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontAscent
methods.description: Returns the ascent metric of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontDescent
methods.description: Returns the descent metric of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontLineSkip
methods.description: Returns the line skip metric of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaces
methods.description: Returns the number of faces in the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceIsFixedWidth
methods.description: Checks if the font face is fixed width.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the font family name.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceStyleName
methods.description: Returns the font style name.

methods.name: TTF_GlyphMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics for a specific glyph.

methods.name: TTF_SizeText
methods.description: Calculates the size of a text string in pixels.

methods.name: TTF_SizeUTF8
methods.description: Calculates the size of a UTF-8 string in pixels.

methods.name: TTF_SizeUNICODE
methods.description: Calculates the size of a Unicode string in pixels.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Solid
methods.description: Renders text in solid mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Solid
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text in solid mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Solid
methods.description: Renders Unicode text in solid mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Shaded
methods.description: Renders text with shading.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Shaded
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text with shading.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Shaded
methods.description: Renders Unicode text with shading.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Blended
methods.description: Renders text in blended mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Blended
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text in blended mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Blended
methods.description: Renders Unicode text in blended mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Solid
methods.description: Renders a glyph in solid mode.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Shaded
methods.description: Renders a glyph with shading.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Blended
methods.description: Renders a glyph in blended mode.
